The array of value arrays for each parameter.

## Signature

```typescript
protected readonly matrixValues: string[][];
```

## Remarks

This two-dimensional array contains the possible values for each parameter. The outer array corresponds one-to-one with <code>matrixKeys</code>, where <code>matrixValues\[i\]</code> contains all possible values for the parameter <code>matrixKeys\[i\]</code>.

The Cartesian product of all these value arrays produces the complete set of combinations.
